paragraphs.source_en: He did not finish speaking. At one and the same moment came the sound of an explosion, a whistle of splinters as from a breaking window frame, a suffocating smell of powder, and Prince Andrew started to one side, raising his arm, and fell on his chest. Several officers ran up to him. From the right side of his abdomen, blood was welling out making a large stain on the grass.

units.source_en: At one and the same moment came the sound of an explosion, a whistle of splinters as from a breaking window frame, a suffocating smell of powder, and Prince Andrew started to one side, raising his arm, and fell on his chest.
Several officers ran up to him.
From the right side of his abdomen, blood was welling out making a large stain on the grass.

paragraphs.source_en: The militiamen with stretchers who were called up stood behind the officers. Prince Andrew lay on his chest with his face in the grass, breathing heavily and noisily.

units.source_en: The militiamen with stretchers who were called up stood behind the officers.
Prince Andrew lay on his chest with his face in the grass, breathing heavily and noisily.

paragraphs.source_en: “What are you waiting for? Come along!”
The peasants went up and took him by his shoulders and legs, but he moaned piteously and, exchanging looks, they set him down again.

units.source_en: The peasants went up and took him by his shoulders and legs, but he moaned piteously and, exchanging looks, they set him down again.

paragraphs.source_en: “Pick him up, lift him, it’s all the same!” cried someone.

units.source_en: “Pick him up, lift him, it’s all the same!”

paragraphs.source_en: They again took him by the shoulders and laid him on the stretcher.

units.source_en: They again took him by the shoulders and laid him on the stretcher.

paragraphs.source_en: “Ah, God! My God! What is it? The stomach? That means death! My God!”—voices among the officers were heard saying.

units.source_en: My God!”—voices among the officers were heard saying.

paragraphs.source_en: “It flew a hair’s breadth past my ear,” said the adjutant.

units.source_en: “It flew a hair’s breadth past my ear,” said the adjutant.

paragraphs.source_en: The peasants, adjusting the stretcher to their shoulders, started hurriedly along the path they had trodden down, to the dressing station.

units.source_en: The peasants, adjusting the stretcher to their shoulders, started hurriedly along the path they had trodden down, to the dressing station.

paragraphs.source_en: “Keep in step! Ah... those peasants!” shouted an officer, seizing by their shoulders and checking the peasants, who were walking unevenly and jolting the stretcher.

units.source_en: shouted an officer, seizing by their shoulders and checking the peasants, who were walking unevenly and jolting the stretcher.

paragraphs.source_en: “Get into step, Fëdor... I say, Fëdor!” said the foremost peasant.
“Now that’s right!” said the one behind joyfully, when he had got into step.

units.source_en: said the one behind joyfully, when he had got into step.

paragraphs.source_en: “Your excellency! Eh, Prince!” said the trembling voice of Timókhin, who had run up and was looking down on the stretcher.

units.source_en: said the trembling voice of Timókhin, who had run up and was looking down on the stretcher.

paragraphs.source_en: Prince Andrew opened his eyes and looked up at the speaker from the stretcher into which his head had sunk deep and again his eyelids drooped.
